tasks.text: Critically discuss the ethical issues raised by the gig economy (e.g. food delivery and e-hailing platforms) in Malaysia. Apply TWO ethical theories (for example utilitarianism, Kantian ethics, virtue ethics or stakeholder theory) to analyse the responsibilities of platforms towards their workers.
Recommend three actions platforms should take to act more ethically, and justify each using your analysis.
Academic writing and referencing (APA 7th, at least 8 academic sources).
